source.title: Senate Preservation Fund (Special and Trust Fund Receipts + Program and Financing)

unit_note: USD millions. Senate Preservation Fund (id 000-5509-0-2-801), combined Special and Trust Fund Receipts + P&F: starts PDF page 34 (printed 46) bottom right, ends PDF page 35 (printed 47) top left (5000/5001 investment memos). Gift-funded account with NO obligations section at all (no 0900/3xxx rows). Receipts: 0100 and 5099 print blank (5099 = 4-4 nets to zero, zero-suppressed), so 1130/2000/2101 are standalone. P&F: 1010 is a NEGATIVE unobligated-balance transfer to account [001-0123] (c2 = -4); 1070 c2 = 1000 + 1010 = 5-4 = 1 is the account's only multi-source balance identity besides 1930 c1 = 1070 + 1101 = 1+4 = 5. 1001 is a non-add memo subset of 1000. 4190 prints blank in all columns.
